chunks: The mosque was made sacred because of the Ka'bah, the sanctuary was made sacred because of the mosque, and ihram became obligatory because of the sanctuary.

key_terms.الْإِحْرَامُ: the consecrated state required for entering the rites of hajj or 'umrah
key_terms.الْحَرَمُ: the sacred sanctuary surrounding the Sacred Mosque
key_terms.الْكَعْبَةِ: the Ka'bah, the central sacred structure in Makkah
key_terms.الْمَسْجِدُ: the Sacred Mosque whose sanctity is linked to the Ka'bah
key_terms.لِعِلَّةِ: by reason of; indicating the cause or basis

ai.seo_question: Why is ihram obligatory in relation to the sacred sanctuary during hajj?
ai.summary: This hadith states a hierarchy of sacredness connected to the rites of hajj. It explains that the sanctity of the mosque relates to the Ka'bah, the sanctity of the haram relates to the mosque, and the obligation of ihram relates to the haram.
